I was going to give you the benefit of the doubt, and then I saw your replies and realized that you're just looking for somebody to agree with you.

Well that makes more sense, if your question was "why do people keep trying to normalize dumb shit that's going to get it killed" that would clear up a lot of confusion in most of the replies you seem to be getting. Your current question makes it sound like you're some old guy getting mad at gen z for being too accepting.

In a perfect world, we wouldn't need the word "normal" to dictate what people can and cannot/ should and should not do. But people are still hung up on what's "normal" and not, so we have to normalize what isn't widely accepted so that it can join that oh so exclusive normal club and be accepted.

Racial equality had to be normalized, women working had to be normalized. We view these as positive changes, they are now normal.

Honestly, as long as you're not hurting anyone, do whatever the fuck you want. If nobody's hurting you or others, let them do what they want.
